messages:
rachel: heads-up — customer trying to onboard with the ruby sampleapp inside a k8s initContainer; they see auth refresh failures that close long-running streams. behavior differs from our node/py clients. anyone seen a kube-ish auth parity issue?

tony: Which gem version and sampleapp tag? Also whether they're using Workload Identity or a metadata proxy?

rachel: gem 0.11.1 (released). sampleapp main. Using GKE Workload Identity (token fetched from metadata server via sidecar). fails reproducibly if metadata latency > ~800ms. logs: 
```
W, [2025-03-02T12:01:05.321Z] WARN -- : 401 Unauthorized from /v1/chat/stream (expired token)
D, [2025-03-02T12:01:05.322Z] DEBUG -- : invoking token provider
D, [2025-03-02T12:01:06.140Z] DEBUG -- : token provider returned after 820ms
E, [2025-03-02T12:01:06.141Z] ERROR -- : stream terminated: Unauthorized
```
Looks like client refreshes but then doesn't reopen the stream. Node client retries and reattaches successfully.

mei: we've had a rule to limit streaming retries to avoid duplicates; maybe auth-refresh attempts are being counted toward that cap. will investigate.

tonY: small nit: ruby sampleapp uses the synchronous provider helper which blocks the streaming thread. could be exposing a race if provider latency crosses the streaming idle window.

rachel: interesting. customer said they saw consistent success when switching to a static API key (not ideal for them).

mei: proposed plan: (1) add an env var REDWOOD_STREAM_AUTH_REFRESH_ATTEMPTS default 2 for streams that can be overridden, (2) add test harness that simulates slow metadata using a tiny http server that sleeps, (3) update sampleapp README with k8s troubleshooting notes.

tonY: agree. also add a short troubleshooting snippet showing how to force delay: `REDWOOD_FAKE_PROVIDER_DELAY_MS=900` so support can repro locally.

rachel: can you also add a note to onboarding playbook about recommending an initial smoke test with a static key to rule out metadata issues? saved me a call.

mei: I'll open a PR. small change in the client options parsing + one integration test. will ping for quick review.

build-bot: CI triggered for branch mei/fix-stream-reopen-auth (ruby-matrix). Jobs queued: unit, integration-simulated-metadata.

mei: PR 4301 opened: mei/fix-stream-reopen-auth. includes: option REDWOOD_STREAM_AUTH_REFRESH_ATTEMPTS, integration test using sleep-server, sampleapp README update, and changelog.

tonY: I'll review after lunch. please keep the default conservative. we don't want extra duplicate outputs by default.

rachel: thanks — once merged i'll rerun the customer's repro and report back here. also adding a short support template for triage steps.

build-bot: integration job 'integration-simulated-metadata' failed: flaky on first run, rerunning. logs: https://ci.internal/54321

mei: reran test to reduce timing sensitivity. added a small backoff in the test harness to avoid startup jitter. will push patch and update PR.

mei: bumped last_message_ts — will post final merge/verify status here.
